verses.sloka: अथ भूमि प्रदेशज्ञाः सूत्र कर्म विशारदाः ।स्व कर्म अभिरताः शूराः खनका यन्त्रकाः तथा ॥२-८०-१॥
verses.transliteration: atha bhūmi pradeśajñāḥ sūtra karma viśāradāḥ ।sva karma abhiratāḥ śūrāḥ khanakā yantrakāḥ tathā ॥2-80-1॥

translations.english: Then surveyors, experts in measurment, energetic and zealous labourers, excavators, engineers, skilled workers, architects, craftsmen, carpenters, roadlevellers, woodcutters, welldiggers, whitewashers, basketmakers, competent supervisors were sent in advance.
translations.hindi: झयोध्याकाण्ड का सतहत्तरबाँ सग समाप्त हुआ । CO) $— र अधष्टसप्ततितमः सगः कई ०३” अथ यात्रां समीहन्तं शत्रुघ्नो लक््मणानुजः । भरतं शोकसन्तप्तमिदं वचनमत्रवीत्‌

verses.sloka: कर्म अन्तिकाः स्थपतयः पुरुषा यन्त्र कोविदाः ।तथा वर्धकयः चैव मार्गिणो वृक्ष तक्षकाः ॥२-८०-२॥
verses.transliteration: karma antikāḥ sthapatayaḥ puruṣā yantra kovidāḥ ।tathā vardhakayaḥ caiva mārgiṇo vṛkṣa takṣakāḥ ॥2-80-2॥

translations.english: Then surveyors, experts in measurment, energetic and zealous labourers, excavators, engineers, skilled workers, architects, craftsmen, carpenters, roadlevellers, woodcutters, welldiggers, whitewashers, basketmakers, competent supervisors were sent in advance.

verses.sloka: कूप काराः सुधा कारा वम्श कर्म कृतः तथा ।समर्था ये च द्रष्टारः पुरतः ते प्रतस्थिरे ॥२-८०-३॥
verses.transliteration: kūpa kārāḥ sudhā kārā vamśa karma kṛtaḥ tathā ।samarthā ye ca draṣṭāraḥ purataḥ te pratasthire ॥2-80-3॥

translations.english: Then surveyors, experts in measurment, energetic and zealous labourers, excavators, engineers, skilled workers, architects, craftsmen, carpenters, roadlevellers, woodcutters, welldiggers, whitewashers, basketmakers, competent supervisors were sent in advance.

verses.sloka: स तु हर्षात् तम् उद्देशम् जन ओघो विपुलः प्रयान् ।अशोभत महा वेगः सागरस्य इव पर्वणि ॥२-८०-४॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu harṣāt tam uddeśam jana ogho vipulaḥ prayān ।aśobhata mahā vegaḥ sāgarasya iva parvaṇi ॥2-80-4॥

translations.english: Like a swollen ocean on a fullmoon day the multitude of people proceeded joyfully with great speed to the appointed place.

verses.sloka: ते स्व वारम् समास्थाय वर्त्म कर्माणि कोविदाः ।करणैः विविध उपेतैः पुरस्तात् सम्प्रतस्थिरे ॥२-८०-५॥
verses.transliteration: te sva vāram samāsthāya vartma karmāṇi kovidāḥ ।karaṇaiḥ vividha upetaiḥ purastāt sampratasthire ॥2-80-5॥

translations.english: Those groups who were skilled in the construction of roads took up their places with every kind of tool and departed ahead of others.
translations.hindi: जब वे दोनों पुरुषसिंद एवं यशस्वी दोनों भाई उठ कर खड़े हुए, तब वे ऐसे जान पड़े, मानों वर्षा और घाम के कारण मलम भाव धारण किए हुए, दो इन्द्र की ध्वजाएं अलग अलग खड़ी हों

verses.sloka: लता वल्लीः च गुल्मामः च स्थाणून् अश्मनएव च ।जनाः ते चक्रिरे मार्गम् चिन्दन्तः विविधान् द्रुमान् ॥२-८०-६॥
verses.transliteration: latā vallīḥ ca gulmāmaḥ ca sthāṇūn aśmanaeva ca ।janāḥ te cakrire mārgam cindantaḥ vividhān drumān ॥2-80-6॥

translations.english: Clearing and cutting branches of various trees and creepers, shrubs, plants branchless trees and hewing boulders, the road was paved by the king's men.

verses.sloka: अवृक्षेषु च देशेषु केचित् वृक्षान् अरोपयन् ।केचित् कुठारैअः टन्कैः च दात्रैः चिन्दन् क्वचित् क्वचित् ॥२-८०-७॥
verses.transliteration: avṛkṣeṣu ca deśeṣu kecit vṛkṣān aropayan ।kecit kuṭhāraiaḥ ṭankaiḥ ca dātraiḥ cindan kvacit kvacit ॥2-80-7॥

translations.english: Some of them, planted saplings in places where there were none, while some others severed trees here and there with axes, hatchets and sickles.

verses.sloka: अपरे वीरण स्तम्बान् बलिनो बलवत्तराः ।विधमन्ति स्म दुर्गाणि स्थलानि च ततः ततः ॥२-८०-८॥
verses.transliteration: apare vīraṇa stambān balino balavattarāḥ ।vidhamanti sma durgāṇi sthalāni ca tataḥ tataḥ ॥2-80-8॥

translations.english: Some other stronger men, plucked the strongrooted tufts of fragrant grass. Here and there they made impassable terrains even.

verses.sloka: अपरे अपूरयन् कूपान् पाम्सुभिः श्वभ्रम् आयतम् ।निम्न भागाम्स् तथा केचित् समामः चक्रुः समन्ततः ॥२-८०-९॥
verses.transliteration: apare apūrayan kūpān pāmsubhiḥ śvabhram āyatam ।nimna bhāgāms tathā kecit samāmaḥ cakruḥ samantataḥ ॥2-80-9॥

translations.english: Some filled wells and chasms with loose soil, while others made low level grounds plain and wide on all sides.

verses.sloka: बबन्धुर् बन्धनीयामः च क्षोद्यान् सम्चुक्षुदुस् तदा ।बिभिदुर् भेदनीयामः च ताम्स् तान् देशान् नराः तदा ॥२-८०-१०॥
verses.transliteration: babandhur bandhanīyāmaḥ ca kṣodyān samcukṣudus tadā ।bibhidur bhedanīyāmaḥ ca tāms tān deśān narāḥ tadā ॥2-80-10॥

translations.english: People threw bridges at places that needed to be bridged. They pulverised stones that obstructed the path and split open big stones to drain out water.

verses.sloka: अचिरेण एव कालेन परिवाहान् बहु उदकान् ।चक्रुर् बहु विध आकारान् सागर प्रतिमान् बहून् ॥२-८०-११॥
verses.transliteration: acireṇa eva kālena parivāhān bahu udakān ।cakrur bahu vidha ākārān sāgara pratimān bahūn ॥2-80-11॥

translations.english: In a short time they constructed many water reservoirs of different shapes capable of holding large volumes of water like the sea.

verses.sloka: निर्जलेषु च देशेषु खानयामासुरुत्तमान् ।उदपानान् बहुविधान् वेदिका परिमण्डितान् ॥२-८०-१२॥
verses.transliteration: nirjaleṣu ca deśeṣu khānayāmāsuruttamān ।udapānān bahuvidhān vedikā parimaṇḍitān ॥2-80-12॥

translations.english: In arid places, various good drinkingwaterwells surrounded by dykes were dug.

verses.sloka: ससुधा कुट्टिम तलः प्रपुष्पित मही रुहः ।मत्त उद्घुष्ट द्विज गणः पताकाभिर् अलम्कृतः ॥२-८०-१३॥
verses.transliteration: sasudhā kuṭṭima talaḥ prapuṣpita mahī ruhaḥ ।matta udghuṣṭa dvija gaṇaḥ patākābhir alamkṛtaḥ ॥2-80-13॥

translations.english: The highway for the army was paved smooth, with its surface decorated with mosaic. It was lined with blossoming trees with flocks of birds intoxicated with singing. It was decked with banners and sprinkled with sandal water and a strewn with flowers of every kind. Like the path of gods, the highway shone with brilliance.

verses.sloka: चन्दन उदक सम्सिक्तः नाना कुसुम भूषितः ।बह्व् अशोभत सेनायाः पन्थाः स्वर्ग पथ उपमः ॥२-८०-१४॥
verses.transliteration: candana udaka samsiktaḥ nānā kusuma bhūṣitaḥ ।bahv aśobhata senāyāḥ panthāḥ svarga patha upamaḥ ॥2-80-14॥

translations.english: The highway for the army was paved smooth, with its surface decorated with mosaic. It was lined with blossoming trees with flocks of birds intoxicated with singing. It was decked with banners and sprinkled with sandal water and a strewn with flowers of every kind. Like the path of gods, the highway shone with brilliance.

verses.sloka: आज्ञाप्य अथ यथा आज्ञप्ति युक्ताः ते अधिकृता नराः ।रमणीयेषु देशेषु बहु स्वादु फलेषु च ॥२-८०-१५॥
verses.transliteration: ājñāpya atha yathā ājñapti yuktāḥ te adhikṛtā narāḥ ।ramaṇīyeṣu deśeṣu bahu svādu phaleṣu ca ॥2-80-15॥

translations.english: Those authorised ordered the artisans to perform their respective tasks. Thereafter, they selected lovely tracts of land filled with trees bearing varieties of sweet fruits as restingplace for great Bharata and decorated them so splendidly, that they looked like ornaments themseleves.

verses.sloka: यो निवेशः तु अभिप्रेतः भरतस्य महात्मनः ।भूयः तम् शोभयाम् आसुर् भूषाभिर् भूषण उपमम् ॥२-८०-१६॥
verses.transliteration: yo niveśaḥ tu abhipretaḥ bharatasya mahātmanaḥ ।bhūyaḥ tam śobhayām āsur bhūṣābhir bhūṣaṇa upamam ॥2-80-16॥

translations.english: Those authorised ordered the artisans to perform their respective tasks. Thereafter, they selected lovely tracts of land filled with trees bearing varieties of sweet fruits as restingplace for great Bharata and decorated them so splendidly, that they looked like ornaments themseleves.

verses.sloka: नक्षत्रेषु प्रशस्तेषु मुहूर्तेषु च तद्विदः ।निवेशम् स्थापयाम् आसुर् भरतस्य महात्मनः ॥२-८०-१७॥
verses.transliteration: nakṣatreṣu praśasteṣu muhūrteṣu ca tadvidaḥ ।niveśam sthāpayām āsur bharatasya mahātmanaḥ ॥2-80-17॥

translations.english: Men wellversed in the study of planetary positions relating to auspicious constellations and auspicious times arranged different restingplaces at different times during the sojourn of great Bharata.

verses.sloka: बहु पाम्सु चयाः च अपि परिखा परिवारिताः ।तन्त्र इन्द्र कील प्रतिमाः प्रतोली वर शोभिताः ॥२-८०-१८॥
verses.transliteration: bahu pāmsu cayāḥ ca api parikhā parivāritāḥ ।tantra indra kīla pratimāḥ pratolī vara śobhitāḥ ॥2-80-18॥

translations.english: They heaped sand and dug moats around the restingplace. It was adorned with wellbuilt highways and broad thoroughfares, lined with mansions surrounded by walls as high as mount Indrakeela. The peaks of those tall residences decorated with flags which looked as if spreading into the sky. (Thus the restingplace) shone like the abode of Indra.

verses.sloka: प्रासाद माला सम्युक्ताः सौध प्राकार सम्वृताः ।पताका शोभिताः सर्वे सुनिर्मित महा पथाः ॥२-८०-१९॥
verses.transliteration: prāsāda mālā samyuktāḥ saudha prākāra samvṛtāḥ ।patākā śobhitāḥ sarve sunirmita mahā pathāḥ ॥2-80-19॥

translations.english: They heaped sand and dug moats around the restingplace. It was adorned with wellbuilt highways and broad thoroughfares, lined with mansions surrounded by walls as high as mount Indrakeela. The peaks of those tall residences decorated with flags which looked as if spreading into the sky. (Thus the restingplace) shone like the abode of Indra.

verses.sloka: विसर्पत्भिर् इव आकाशे विटन्क अग्र विमानकैः ।समुच्च्रितैः निवेशाः ते बभुः शक्र पुर उपमाः ॥२-८०-२०॥
verses.transliteration: visarpatbhir iva ākāśe viṭanka agra vimānakaiḥ ।samuccritaiḥ niveśāḥ te babhuḥ śakra pura upamāḥ ॥2-80-20॥

translations.english: They heaped sand and dug moats around the restingplace. It was adorned with wellbuilt highways and broad thoroughfares, lined with mansions surrounded by walls as high as mount Indrakeela. The peaks of those tall residences decorated with flags which looked as if spreading into the sky. (Thus the restingplace) shone like the abode of Indra.

verses.sloka: जाह्नवीम् तु समासाद्य विविध द्रुम काननाम् ।शीतल अमल पानीयाम् महा मीन समाकुलाम् ॥२-८०-२१॥
verses.transliteration: jāhnavīm tu samāsādya vividha druma kānanām ।śītala amala pānīyām mahā mīna samākulām ॥2-80-21॥

translations.english: The reached Ganga with its cool and limpid waters abounding in large fishes, its bank lined with groves of various trees.
translations.hindi: ता स फ फ ःफक्‍स्७ परिमृद्‌नन्तौ--माजंयन्तौ । लोकल कल्ल सींग कटे हुए बैल की तरह, वे प्रथिवी पर गिर कर, छट- पटा. रहे थे । उस समय प्रशस्त स्वभाव वाले सव क्ष और दोनों सुजङुमारों के पिता के पुरोहित

verses.sloka: सचन्द्र तारा गण मण्डितम् यथा ।नभः क्षपायाम् अमलम् विराजते ।नर इन्द्र मार्गः स तथा व्यराजत ।क्रमेण रम्यः शुभ शिल्पि निर्मितः ॥२-८०-२२॥
verses.transliteration: sacandra tārā gaṇa maṇḍitam yathā ।nabhaḥ kṣapāyām amalam virājate ।nara indra mārgaḥ sa tathā vyarājata ।krameṇa ramyaḥ śubha śilpi nirmitaḥ ॥2-80-22॥

translations.english: The lovely royal road constructed in an orderly fashion by eminent craftsmen looked splendid like the clear sky decorated with by the Moon and clusters of stars. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightieth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: बसिष्ठ जी, भरत जी को उठा कर कहने लगे। हे विओ ! आपके पिता का अग्निसंस्कार हुए, आज तेरह दिन हो चुके
